label: Session permission

option.arbiterHint: Arbiter takes over new calls in this session: rules and review approve or deny automatically, and the approval mode decides whether a human is needed.
option.disableHint: Stops taking over new calls in this session; if the execution boundary was widened, the host permission first narrows back to workspace write before it is handed back.

confirm.title: Switch to full access?
confirm.description: Full access reduces host confirmation steps, so the agent can directly perform more operations, including sensitive files, commands and network requests. Use it only when you trust the current task.
confirm.acknowledge: I understand the risk and want to continue

hostUnavailable: The host permission menu is unavailable; this control can still enable or disable auto review.

error.sessionRequired: No session is available, so the permission cannot be changed.
error.sessionUnknown: The host does not recognise the current session; the permission was not changed.
error.invalidAction: The request was invalid; the permission was not changed.
error.boundaryNotOverridable: The execution boundary is plugin configuration and cannot be overridden separately inside a session.
error.boundaryUnconfirmed: The host did not confirm the execution boundary, so this session stays blocked.
error.boundaryNotApplied: The host refused to apply the execution boundary; the permission was not changed.
error.recordUnavailable: The session record is unavailable; the permission was not changed.
error.recordFailed: Writing the session record failed; the permission was not changed.
error.pluginDisabled: The plugin master switch is off, so no session can be enabled.
error.stopping: The plugin is stopping; the permission was not changed.
error.requestFailed: The request failed; the last confirmed state is still shown: {detail}
error.hostUnavailableDetail: The host permission command did not take effect; the last confirmed state is still shown.
error.commandNotApplied: The host command did not actually take effect; the last confirmed state is still shown.

preset.readOnlyHint: Read-only access: no file modifications and no operations that need write access.
preset.workspaceWriteHint: Workspace write: file writes are limited to the current workspace, and other operations are confirmed by the host.
preset.fullAccessHint: Full access: fewer host confirmation steps, so the agent can directly perform more operations.
